g.text: A trajectory with no unique nearest rule, or a large distance to it,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #64748b

g.text: is a label the data does not support.

g.text: Evolutionary curves are the reconstructed model at the two parameter points its source text declares; route points are pooled decision

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #64748b

g.text: frequencies from 10 races and 186 decisions per route and risk. The two objects are not samples of the same process, and nearest-rule labels

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #64748b

g.text: are a distance to a fixed rule, not a recovered policy.
